Final-fortnight yields are extrapolated after the measured cohort window; this is not 52-week combat telemetry.

method: 500 modeled accounts; five player policies with hours/session distributions, weekly churn, Deed rates, withdrawal/sink/market decisions. All claims include finite tester grants. Opening third-party market float is pre-existing circulation, separately conserved and depleted. No retained-fee burn, unfunded trades or automatic controller reductions.
